verses.original: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵ֣את מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם בֵּ֥ית יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב מֵעַ֥ם לֹעֵֽז׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl bə·ṣêṯ mim·miṣ·rā·yim bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ mê·‘am lō·‘êz
verses.literal: When Israel departed from Egypt the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue
Judah became [God’s] sanctuary Israel His dominion

verses.original: הַיָּ֣ם רָ֭אָה וַיָּנֹ֑ס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן יִסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yām rā·’āh way·yā·nōs hay·yar·dên yis·sōḇ lə·’ā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: The sea observed and fled the Jordan turned back

verses.original: הֶֽ֭הָרִים רָקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי־ צֹֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: he·hā·rîm rā·qə·ḏū ḵə·’ê·lîm gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ kiḇ·nê- ṣōn
verses.literal: the mountains skipped like rams the hills like lambs . . .

verses.original: מַה־ לְּךָ֣ הַ֭יָּם כִּ֣י תָנ֑וּס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן תִּסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: mah- lə·ḵā hay·yām kî ṯā·nūs hay·yar·dên tis·sōḇ lə·’ā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: Why was it O sea that you fled O Jordan that you turned back

verses.original: הֶֽ֭הָרִים תִּרְקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי־ צֹֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: he·hā·rîm tir·qə·ḏū ḵə·’ê·lîm gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ kiḇ·nê- ṣōn
verses.literal: O mountains that you skipped like rams O hills like lambs . . .

verses.original: ח֣וּלִי אָ֑רֶץ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אָ֭דוֹן מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.literal: Tremble O earth at the presence of the Lord at the presence of the God of Jacob

verses.original: הַהֹפְכִ֣י הַצּ֣וּר אֲגַם־ מָ֑יִם חַ֝לָּמִ֗ישׁ לְמַעְיְנוֹ־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hō·p̄ə·ḵî haṣ·ṣūr ’ă·ḡam- mā·yim ḥal·lā·mîš lə·ma‘·yə·nōw- mā·yim
verses.literal: who turned the rock into a pool . . . the flint into a fountain of water
